title: Support evaluation comparison existence
statement:
Let f:X→Y be a scheme morphism, c a compactification of f, l a natural number,
and b:BasicData c l. For a coefficient sequence B and level n, the normalized proper/open
support evaluation comparison exists.

source.place: Zheng Lemma 5.16; Stacks Tag 0GL6, proper/open evaluation mate construction.

proof.text: Construct the ordinary identity-on-sections comparison, take its canonical adjunction mate, and apply exact localization. The mate equations and their pasting give the prescribed normalization for this component.

proof_origin.place: Zheng Lemma 5.16; Stacks Tag 0GL6, proper/open evaluation mate construction.

lean.statement:
theorem supportEvaluation_nonempty
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} {c : Compactification f} {l : ℕ}
    (b : BasicData c l) (B : Coefficients.{u} l) (n : ℕ) :
    Nonempty (SupportEvaluation (b.support B) n
      (b.evaluationX B n) (b.evaluationZ B n) (b.evaluationY B n))
